scenarios.name: 08 source and 09 formal reference check

scenarios.name: Changed source invalidates summary only where dependent
scenarios.expected: Exact blob change marks affected summaries/index stale; others retain validity

scenarios.name: Unregistered new mechanism is reported
scenarios.expected: Repo source scan enumerates unregistered entry and count; no silent exclusion

scenarios.name: Registered missing source fails closed
scenarios.expected: Missing canonical source is included in missing and blocks dependent load

scenarios.name: Filtered scope reports counts
scenarios.expected: Filtered historical results cannot claim exhaustive coverage

scenarios.name: Unknown lifecycle task remains discoverable
scenarios.expected: Unknown or freeform lifecycle does not automatically hide T1 or claim archived

scenarios.name: Insufficient context budget preserves B0
scenarios.expected: Required bodies not silently truncated; receipt BLOCKED with budget diagnostics

scenarios.name: Human optional choice bound to current session
scenarios.expected: New session surfaces prior choice but does not silently inherit optional authorization

scenarios.name: TOCTOU source commit drift
scenarios.expected: Changed commit between discovery and load causes re-resolve or BLOCKED, not stale READY

scenarios.name: Receipt distinguishes directory summary from full loading
scenarios.expected: Receipt reports exact body bytes/blob, summary-only, missing, stale and effect/auth separately

Full content loading and mechanism authorization are separate facts
